lastCompletedStory.title: Config-driven orchestrator window: default 200k, replace 1M model-prefix derivation

nextStoryContext: orchestratorContextWindow() (src/orchestrator/context-window.ts) is now a thin pass-through to the new readOrchContextWindow (src/config/models.ts): reads [loop] orch_context_window from project.toml, defaulting fail-safe to 200000 (DEFAULT_ORCH_CONTEXT_WINDOW) on any missing/malformed/non-integer/<=0 value. The prior 1M-by-model-prefix derivation (MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOWS, OPUS_CONTEXT_WINDOW, and the readPhaseModel('orchestrator') call inside context-window.ts) is fully removed -- grep confirms zero remaining references in src/ or test/. isOverContextBackstop's strict-greater boundary semantics (occupancy > window * fraction) are untouched; with the new 200000 default the 0.80 backstop now fires above 160000, which is reachable in a real session (unlike the old 800k threshold under a 1M assumption that a flat-subscription session never approaches). test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts's makeBackstopDeps test helper still hardcodes contextWindow: 1_000_000 as an explicit per-test fixture override (not derived from production defaults) -- this is intentional and unchanged, since every test in that file passes contextWindow explicitly and never relies on the orchestratorContextWindow() production default. scripts/cam/project.toml's [loop] section (meta_loop, worker_isolation) has NOT been given an orch_context_window key -- the notes on this story marked that optional since the 200000 default already matches the real subscription ceiling, and I left it unset. jq shows no remaining prd.json stories with passes:false as of this write; this was the last story in the CAM-172 PRD (US-001/002/003 all done) -- next agent should check prd.json fresh rather than assume more stories exist under this branch.

officialDocsValidated.summary: This story is a pure internal config-reader change (TOML section/key read via the existing loadConfig wrapper, already validated in prior stories); no new external library surface was exercised.
